subject: Request: Welcome credit + promotional rate carveout for SolaceMetrics PoC
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@solacemetrics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC request and volume profile

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team liked the latency profile and the cost analysis. We're close to an internal go/no-go for a 6‑8 week PoC of Redwood hosted inference. Two asks from procurement and engineering:

- Can you provide a small onboarding credit (we're estimating ~30k generated tokens for the PoC) to avoid creating a card for a short trial period?
- If the PoC goes well, can Redwood extend a promotional rate for the first year (we're targeting a 15% discount to your published rate) — this helps us model costs for procurement.

Scope attached (SolaceMetrics_PoC_scope.pdf). Happy to jump on a 20‑minute call to align.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Product
SolaceMetrics

---
Attachment: SolaceMetrics_PoC_scope.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@solacemetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC request and volume profile

Hi Samira — great to meet you and glad the demo hit the mark.

High-level proposal (subject to internal approval):
- One-time onboarding credit: $1,200 equivalent (~30k generated tokens) applied to the account at activation.
- PoC trial window: 60 days from provisioning.
- Promotional commercial: 15% off list rates on hosted API for the first 12 months from conversion.

I'll need an exec sign-off for the combined credit + rate concession (pricing carveout). Looping in Marissa (go-to-market approvals) and Priyom (finance) to confirm authority and any conversion commitments we should require (e.g., 6‑month Minimum Commit).

Samira — if this looks reasonable, can you confirm the PoC start target week and whether SolaceMetrics can commit to a 6‑month paid term after conversion? That will speed internal approval.

I've attached a draft pricing sheet for reference: BLK-solacemetrics-pricing-proposal.xlsx.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request — SolaceMetrics combined onboarding credit + promo rate (DEAL-2027-0473)

Marissa / Priyom — requesting approval for a combined concession on the SolaceMetrics PoC. Summary:
- Customer: SolaceMetrics (data‑processing SaaS, ML inference for anomaly detection).
- Asks: $1,200 onboarding credit (approx. 30k gen tokens), 60‑day PoC window, and 15% promotional rate on hosted API for 12 months post-conversion.
- Proposed commercial guardrail: requires a 6‑month minimum paid term upon conversion or $3,000 minimum invoice pro‑rata.
- Strategic angle: SolaceMetrics is in advanced negotiations with two competitors; this win helps us establish a reference in the telemetry space.

Attached: BLK-solacemetrics-pricing-proposal.xlsx and the customer's scope. I can route the final package for signature via DocuSign (link below) if we get a green light.

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/solacemetrics-offer
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-2027-0473

Thanks for a quick read — we need a decision to hit the customer's target start 4/19.

—Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — SolaceMetrics combined onboarding credit + promo rate (DEAL-2027-0473)

Thanks Jordan — reviewed. I'm comfortable approving the onboarding credit ($1,200) and the 60‑day PoC window under the following conditions:

1) We require a written conversion commitment: either a 6‑month paid commitment or a $3,000 minimum first invoice (pro‑rata OK).
2) The 15% promo rate will require finance sign-off and must be limited to hosted API only (no dedicated/private discounts).
3) Legal should run a short T&Cs carveout to ensure usage limits and misuse protections are included.

Priyom — can you review the 15% promo ask and confirm whether finance can authorize it for the first 12 months given the above guardrails? If you need a revenue forecast or ARR impact model, Jordan can paste the estimated run‑rates.

If we can get yes on the promo rate, I will instruct ops to apply the credit and ask Legal to draft the DocuSign packet.

—Marissa
VP, Growth & Commercials
Redwood Inference

OK — finance reviewed the ask and will authorize the combined concession with the conditions below:

- Onboarding credit: approved ($1,200). Ops to apply credit on activation and flag the account.
- PoC window: 60 days approved.
- Promotional rate: 15% off hosted API for 12 months — approved conditional on:
    a) Signed conversion commitment (6‑month paid minimum or $3,000 minimum first invoice).
    b) A short revenue forecast in HubSpot (Jordan, please add estimated monthly usage after conversion).
    c) Promo limited to hosted API; no discounts for Dedicated/Private deployments unless routed back to Finance.

Attached final terms (SolaceMetrics_Final_Terms_v1.docx). Once Jordan confirms the customer's conversion commitment language and we get the HubSpot forecast, Legal will finalize and we'll route DocuSign.

Approving now so Jordan can move forward with the customer and meet the 4/19 start target.
